sources.author: Southport Guide; individual photographer not identified
observations: Broad white surround, continuous slim white window grid with green-grey aggregate spandrels, three broad ground zones, separate red name/furniture signs and central heart emblem. Far upper end partly hidden by foliage.

2026-10-22 second pass: window casement/transom pattern retained; slender panel retainers and darker glazing seals are visible. White fascia has broad sheet joints, not fine masonry courses. Narrow vertical red tiles visible on piers.

sources.author: Bertie Cunningham / Southport BID, credited by Andrew Brown
sources.capture: Unknown; article updated 2025-08-27; image URL April 2024
observations: Deep central recess, glazed returns, red tiled piers and door frames, black plinth and dark steps, soffit downlights, raised white fascia lettering. WELCOME to BHF Southport above doors.

2026-10-22 close review: one continuous framed welcome board in the central transom; three circular recessed soffit lights, red entrance framing with small metal hinge/closer hardware, narrow vertical tile courses and tiled threshold. All small dimensions estimated.

sources.capture: Imagery capture date not displayed; reviewed 2026-10-22
observations: Three capped housings on Glebe Place roof edge; long church-side brick/parapet strip with steps; four fan-topped plant units beside a long pale cabinet on framed rear platform.

Rear rectangular feature has raised walls around a lower exposed surface; interpreted as shallow external recess. Low elongated pale/rust rooflight or vent, scattered caps and pipe cluster also visible.
No readable access doors or stair flights: none invented. Relative outlines clear, heights and equipment functions unresolved.
Top-down frame is normalized to existing estimated building footprint, not used as a surveyed dimension source.

limitations: No reference photographs or photo-derived maps distributed. Procedural textures and hand-authored emblem interpretation only; BHF identity remains its trademark.
Mixed-date exterior reconstruction, not a current survey.
All metric dimensions, fourteen-module count at obscured far end, rear envelope and roof features approximate.
No interiors, stock displays or unreadable notices; opaque glazing.
Church garden and exact side-wall attachment deferred to church pass.
Three edge housings are visible but their access/ventilation function is unresolved; no doors or stair runs invented.
Rectangular rear feature interpreted as a shallow external walled recess with two higher walls; actual internal depth is unknown.
Elongated pale/rust feature may be a rooflight or ventilation hood; opaque shallow pitched interpretation only.
Plant silhouette and four fan tops observed; heights, cabinet panel divisions and guardrail construction approximate.
Rear and side ownership boundaries against adjoining properties remain unverified.
